messages:
maria_sales: Inbound security questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ) from Acorn Payments. Need intake + assign. Customer expects answers by Fri EOD. They're asking about key rotation, SOC2, and EU data residency. PII involved. Attached: https://redwood.app/drive/acorn/SIG_2026.pdf

ticket-bot: Created internal ticket SR-4821 and linked to deal ACN-2026-07. Due date set to 2026-03-28.

kyle_sec: On it. @devon_se do you want to own the questionnaire responses? I can cover infra controls + KMS rotation bits.

devon_se: I can take the controls section and CAIQ mapping. Need access to SOC2 report and our key rotation procedure. @maria_sales can you confirm which deployment they plan to use (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)?

maria_sales: They plan to start on Hosted API and may migrate to Dedicated later. Customer region: EU (Frankfurt). Uploaded their SIG here: https://redwood.app/drive/acorn/SIG_2026.pdf

kyle_sec: Thanks. I'll draft answers for Data classification, encryption (at rest/in transit), and KMS rotation policy. Quick note for the answers: Hosted uses provider-managed keys (SSE-KMS), Private supports customer-managed KMS with `rotation_interval = 90d`. I'll cite our docs.

devon_se: Where is the SOC2 report? I only see the Confluence summary.

maria_sales: SOC2 full report is in Confluence: https://redwood.app/confluence/soc2/2025-redwood-soc2.pdf. I gave view access to acorn_sales@acorn.com for their due diligence.

kyle_sec: Assigning SR-4821 to myself and adding @devon_se as assignee. ETA for initial pass: Tue. @ticket-bot update owner=kyle_sec assignees=devon_se eta=2026-03-24

ticket-bot: SR-4821 updated: owner=kyle_sec; assignees=devon_se; status=In Progress; next_update=2026-03-25.

devon_se: Heads-up — Acorn asked whether we support FIDO2 for passwordless auth. We don't provide FIDO as a managed service; recommend customer self-manage and we can document integration patterns. I'll add that guidance to the answers.

maria_sales: Also customer flagged they need a "key rotation proof" sample. Can we provide a redactable export or process attestation?

kyle_sec: Yes — we can provide a process statement and redactable audit excerpts (no raw keys). I'll include a sample rotation log schema and phrase it as an attestation in the SIG response.

maria_sales: :thumbsup: Great — I'll notify Acorn that we're on it and set expectations for Tue update.
